issue_request: FHIR-52911 was Applied for R6 with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. It requested removal of the FamilyMemberHistory.participant backbone and replacement with FamilyMemberHistory.recorder 0..1 and FamilyMemberHistory.asserter 0..1, including the listed Reference targets and definitions.

additional_context: FHIR-37477 originally added participant for recorder-like participation, and FHIR-41404 addressed Group/family as a source in the same artifact family. Patient Care minutes on 2025-10-02 noted possible future deprecation guidance or reopening after PR review, but the seed remains Applied and follow-up Jira/Zulip searches found no final superseding decision.

The remaining participant hits are commented historical XML text and a generated-looking SVG diagram, not authoritative conformance source.
